title: Measure review-round ages and replace the PR ledger's 72 hours
why: Retrospective audit of stands item 572 (coordinator 12:59 CST Nov 12): the 72-hour window was a guessed number.
note: Measure how old review rounds get, and set the PR ledger window from that measure, not a stored 72 h. [23:16 CST Nov 15, triage] Owner pick a on item 572 (ruling own-572-a-ledger-by-age-only): no 72 h number; the ledger flags a stalled review only by an age measured here. A record marked done whose lane check never passed belongs to its lane, not the batch runner.
